graph_nodes.func: Save project: name guards (HLR-164) over `self.workarea`, missing-source refusal, `project_dir = parent_resolved / cleaned`, reparse refusal of the target, image decision and plan (`_plan_project_save`), plan refusal, then `project_dir.mkdir`, then validate_project_files and the single-MAC / single-A2L refusals (rolled back by `_abort_save`), the plan's placements, the gather, the manifest write and the commit block. The parent folder is only checked with `is_dir()`. 8b changes: (a) refuse a parent that does not resolve to `self.workarea` before any folder (LLR-171.3); (b) the single-MAC / single-A2L refusals run before `mkdir`, as a plan-time decision (LED .66, LED .63 (b)); (c) on a save to a new name with an open project, copy every sub-folder file the plan names through `place_into_workarea`, each into its relative path, and paint the skipped links (LLR-171.1); (d) the free-space refusal before the folder exists (LLR-171.1).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._plan_project_save
examples: (TC-B100-59, test_tc_b100_59_open_project_unchanged) the open project P1 with `firmware.s19` and `firmware.mac` saved again → plan.target_kind "open project", rows image "keep", mac "keep", manifest "new" (holds at ebe6d0c)
(TC-B100-59 Inc 8b arm, LLR-167.6 "one row per sub-folder with its file count") open project P with `flows/f1.json`, Q new → plan holds a sub-folder row for "flows" with count `1` (target (8b))

(LLR-167.6 "computing a plan writes 0 bytes … computes 0 digests", test_tc_b100_59_planning_writes_nothing_and_hashes_no_payload) a plan computed → `0` bytes written (holds at ebe6d0c; 8b must keep it with the walk)
graph_nodes.func: builds the PlannedFile list (image, MAC, A2L, the Patch Editor document) with digests, the target kind (new, open project, merge) and the manifest keys, then calls plan_project_save. No sub-folder of the open project is planned. 8b changes: one walk of `current_project_dir` (when the target is not the open project) that prunes every `_is_reparse_point` directory and skips file links gives the sub-folder files, their total and the skipped links (LLR-171.1); the free-space refusal and the single-MAC / single-A2L refusals become plan refusals (LED .66).

graph_nodes.name: plan_project_save
examples: (TC-B100-59, test_tc_b100_59_fresh_folder) target `P1` new, files [image `firmware.s19`] → rows image "new" and manifest `project.json` "new" (holds at ebe6d0c)
(TC-B100-59, test_tc_b100_59_refused_plan_writes_nothing) refusal set → rows `0` (holds at ebe6d0c)
(TC-B100-59 Inc 8b arm) files with `flows/f1.json` and `reports/r.md` into a new Q → rows for "flows" and "reports", each count `1` (target (8b))
graph_nodes.func: pure planner: one row per top-level file (and the document under its home) with its predicted landing name and action word, plus the project.json row; writes nothing and hashes nothing. SavePlan has no sub-folder row and no skipped-links field. 8b changes: one row per sub-folder with its file count and the skipped links (LLR-167.6), the sub-folder files predicted under their relative path; a refusal (free space, single MAC / A2L) keeps a row-less plan.

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._abort_save
examples: (HLR-167 threshold "a blocked change document → 0 files, 0 folders left") a failed save that created the folder → `0` folders left (holds at ebe6d0c)
graph_nodes.func: rolls a failed Save project back: removes exactly the files and folders this save created, restores a replaced manifest and the in-memory state. Unchanged by 8b, but every sub-folder copy and every sub-folder 8b creates must join `placed_files` / `created_dirs`.

graph_nodes.name: _plan_row_mismatch
examples: (TC-B100-59, test_tc_b100_59_landing_that_differs_from_its_row_rolls_back) a landing that differs from its row → a mismatch text, the save rolled back (holds at ebe6d0c)
graph_nodes.func: checks one landed placement against its plan row; a mismatch aborts the save. 8b: each sub-folder copy is one more placement to check against its row (if sub-folder files get per-file rows).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp.list_projects

(test_tc_b100_04_list_projects_omits_reserved_homes_casefolded) a reserved home in any case → not listed (holds at ebe6d0c)
(AT-B100-11, TC-B100-62 Inc 8b arm) `workarea/evil` a junction into another work area's project → projects `0` entries named "evil" (target (8b))
graph_nodes.func: every direct child directory of `self.workarea` whose case-folded name is not a reserved home. `is_dir()` follows a junction; no reparse or containment check. 8b changes: skip a folder for which `_is_reparse_point` is true (checked before any resolve) and require `contained_in_workarea` (LLR-171.4).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._handle_load_project
examples: (AT-B100-10, TC-B100-32, P-12) project with files "firmware.a2l", "project.json" → status "No supported files in project: P" (holds at ebe6d0c; RED side of AT-B100-10)
(TC-B100-32, LLR-171.2) the same A2L-only project `p04` → `3` A2L tags, current_project set, current_file `None` (target (8b))
(TC-B100-32, LLR-171.2) a folder whose `project.json` records no missing file and holds no data and no A2L → status holds "no data or A2L file" and "load a file and Save project" (target (8b))
(TC-B100-62 Inc 8b arm, LLR-171.4) name `evil`, a junction into another work area → `0` loads (target (8b))
graph_nodes.func: Load project: `project_dir = self.workarea / name`, exists check, validate_project_files, `No supported files in project` when there is no data file, the session reset, build_variant_set, the manifest, check_project_files, the A2L parse (`_load_a2l_data_with_cache`), choose_install_set (a second `No supported files` when no variant and no MAC), the document reopen, the image install loop, the announcement. No reparse or containment check on `project_dir`. 8b changes: (a) a project with no data file and one A2L resets the session, sets the project and `_variant_set = build_variant_set(name, [])`, attaches the A2L through the A2L load path and reports it (LLR-171.2); (b) neither data nor A2L → the `no data or A2L file` tokens; (c) refuse a project folder for which `_is_reparse_point` is true, before `resolve()`, and require `contained_in_workarea` (LLR-171.4).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._reset_project_session
examples: (LLR-171.2) an A2L-only load → the reset runs before the A2L attach, so current_a2l_path is the project's A2L after the load, not the previous session's (target (8b))
graph_nodes.func: the one reset seam of a project load: clears the image, MAC and A2L attachments, the A2L path and data, rebinds ChangeService; returns the outgoing document's entry count. Unchanged by 8b; the A2L-only branch must call it (LLR-171.2 "reset the session").

graph_nodes.name: choose_install_set
examples: (LLR-171.2, p04) data_files `0`, a2l_files [`firmware.a2l`] → install.variant `None`, install.mac `None`, install.a2l "firmware.a2l" (holds at ebe6d0c by reading the code)
graph_nodes.func: the load fallback rule: the recorded variant when valid, else the next valid one; then the MAC and the A2L. With no data file the variant and the MAC are `None` and the A2L is `a2l_files[0]`. Unchanged by 8b; the A2L-only branch reads its `a2l`.

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._load_a2l_data_with_cache
examples: (TC-B100-32 threshold, p04) the project's `firmware.a2l` → a payload with `3` tags (holds at ebe6d0c by the threshold's source probe)
graph_nodes.func: parses an A2L (with the cache) and returns the payload. Called by _handle_load_project before the install. Unchanged by 8b.

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp.load_a2l_from_path
examples: (test_b100_save_image.py:904, locked "a2l") `firmware.a2l` from a folder outside the work area → current_a2l_path not `None` (holds at ebe6d0c)
graph_nodes.func: the standalone A2L load: resolve the path, refuse with "Project already has an A2L file." when `current_project` is set and the project already holds an A2L, copy into `workarea/temp` through copy_into_workarea, parse, set current_a2l_path to the temp copy, update the view. Unchanged by 8b unless the A2L-only branch reuses it as "the A2L load path" (see baseline-notes C4).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._active_project_dir
examples: (LED .50 R3-2) current_project `P1`, current_project_dir `None` → project_dir ends "P1" under the work area, unresolved (holds at ebe6d0c by reading the code)
graph_nodes.func: the open project's folder, unresolved: `current_project_dir`, else `workarea / current_project`. Every in-project writer reads it. Unchanged by 8b.

graph_nodes.name: validate_project_files

out.raw: tuple(list[Path] data_files, list[Path] a2l_files, Optional[str] error)

examples: (P-12) folder with "firmware.a2l", "project.json" → data_files `0` items, a2l_files "firmware.a2l", error `None` (holds at ebe6d0c)
graph_nodes.func: lists the direct regular-file children of the project: S19/HEX/MAC as data, A2L apart; more than one MAC or A2L is an error. Its lists feed the single-MAC / single-A2L refusals in Save project and the A2L-only decision in Load. Unchanged by 8b.

graph_nodes.name: build_variant_set
examples: (LLR-171.2 negative control) project_name `P`, data_files `0` items → a variant set with `0` variants, not `None`, so the next Load file rewrites project.json (target (8b) for the caller; the function's empty-list result holds by reading the code)
graph_nodes.func: the project's variants from its S19/HEX data files, in deterministic order. LLR-171.2 calls it with an empty list for an A2L-only project. Unchanged by 8b.

graph_nodes.name: place_into_workarea
examples: (test_tc_b100_62_junction_destination_is_refused_nothing_written) a destination that is a junction into another work area → WorkareaContainmentError, `0` bytes written (holds at ebe6d0c)
graph_nodes.func: the one placement function: source and destination reparse checks, size cap, private staging, containment in this work area (`_guarded_destination` → contained_in_workarea), byte-identical reuse or the lowest free `_<N>`. Unchanged by 8b; LLR-171.1's sub-folder copies go through it.

graph_nodes.name: contained_in_workarea
examples: (test_tc_b100_62_containment_predicate) a path under another `.s19tool/workarea` → contained `False` (holds at ebe6d0c)
graph_nodes.func: true iff the path, after resolving every link and junction, is inside `workarea.resolve()`. Unchanged by 8b; LLR-171.4 adds list_projects and _handle_load_project as callers.

graph_nodes.name: _is_reparse_point
examples: (TC-B100-31, LLR-171.1) a directory junction inside P → is_link `True` (holds at ebe6d0c by the S-03 probe the requirement cites)
graph_nodes.func: true when the path is a symbolic link or a Windows reparse point (junction); the path need not exist. Unchanged by 8b; LLR-171.1's walk prunes with it and LLR-171.4 adds list_projects and _handle_load_project as callers.

graph_nodes.name: write_project_manifest
examples: (test_tc_b100_62_manifest_write_refuses_a_project_swapped_for_a_junction) project_root swapped for a junction → written `None`, `0` bytes written outside (holds at ebe6d0c)
graph_nodes.func: the manifest seam: serialize, `_check_destination_contained` with this app's work area (`ensure_workarea(base_dir)`), stage, `os.replace`, re-check after the replace. Unchanged by 8b; the eighth writer of LLR-171.4's threshold.
